name: tokamon
description: 정해진 시간, 정해진 장소에서 토큰을 받는 웹앱

scripts.deploy: cd contracts && forge build 2>/dev/null || true && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:DeployScript --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8999 --broadcast --unlocked --sender 0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266
scripts.dev: npm run anvil & sleep 2 && npm run deploy && npm run server & npm run client
scripts.stop: pkill -f 'anvil|node server|vite' 2>/dev/null || kill $(lsof -ti:8999,3001,5173) 2>/dev/null; echo '✓ 모든 프로세스 종료 완료'
scripts.clean: cd contracts && forge clean && rm -rf out cache
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
